newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Finmin to guarantee VHV loan by year-end.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Finmin to guarantee VHV loan by year-end.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry on Wednesday said it would sign a guarantee for a $200 million loan for state-owned construction firm Vodohospodarska Vystavba a.s. (VHV) by the end of the year.
"By the end of the year, the ministry should sign the loan and the loan guarantee contracts with Vodohospodarska," ministry press official Zuzana Brutenicova told Reuters.
In September, the Slovak government said it had approved the guarantee for the 10-year loan, which will be lead-managed by JP Morgan, for its hydro-construction projects.
The loan is to finance the completion of the Gabcikovo dam project and a new dam on the River Vah at Zilina, northern Slovakia.
